title: Make the hero destination and shipping threshold explicit

hypothesis.if: we name the men's shoe destination and show the existing shipping threshold beside the hero CTA
hypothesis.then: eligible visitors will be more likely to complete a purchase
hypothesis.because: the current SHOP MEN label does not name the destination and the shipping threshold is elsewhere on the page

evidence: Rendered Allbirds homepage: a[data-analytics-full-bleed-hero-cta-name="SHOP MEN"] reads SHOP MEN and links to the men's Dasher NZ product.
Rendered homepage quote: Free ground shipping on orders over $100. Verify policy and market before launch.
rationale: Demonstration only. These are synthetic calculator inputs, not Allbirds traffic. Confirm eligible audience analytics before planning a launch.
primary_metric: Purchase conversion rate: unique assigned eligible visitors with a paid order within 7 days / all unique assigned eligible visitors. Source: existing purchase events joined to platform assignment. Wait 7 days after enrollment closes before final analysis.
guardrail_metrics: Revenue per assigned visitor must not fall by more than 10% relative at the planned horizon.
Stop for a reproducible new cart or checkout blocker; monitor payment error rate daily and stop if it rises by 2 percentage points for a full day versus control.
audience: US homepage visitors eligible for the experiment, excluding staff, bots and visitors in another hero experiment. Persistent visitor assignment. The shipping claim applies only to the verified US policy.
css: [data-cro-hero-clarity][data-cro-insert] { position: relative; z-index: 2; margin-top: 10px; max-width: 100%; color: #fff; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; text-shadow: 0 1px 3px #000; } [data-cro-hero-clarity][data-cro-insert] p { margin: 0; }
stop_rules: Inspect assignment balance before analysis; flag a sample-ratio mismatch at p < 0.01, investigate and do not declare a winner with unexplained imbalance.
qa_checklist: Confirm the CTA keeps its original href and accessible name matches the visible label.
Confirm the shipping threshold remains accurate for the targeted country and no existing shipping-delay notice is hidden.
Check trust line contrast on the actual hero image and fit at 375px, 390px and desktop widths.
